meta.name: canvas-design
meta.description: Create beautiful visual art in .png and .pdf documents using design philosophy. You should use this skill when the user asks to create a poster, piece of art, design, or other static piece. Create original visual designs, never copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.

copy.tagline: 用设计理念创作精美视觉作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成原创海报、插画或静态视觉设计。
copy.tagline_en: Create beautiful visual art with design philosophy
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate original posters, illustrations, or static visual designs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会先创建一份设计理念文档（.md），再根据该理念生成一张视觉海报（.png 或 .pdf）。作品强调手工质感，文字极少，以图形、色彩和构图为主。
howto.when: 当你要求制作海报、艺术作品、设计图等静态视觉内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一张极简主义风格的海报。
say.note: Claude 会先写设计理念，再生成海报。

say.text: 为我的摄影展做一张宣传图。
say.note: Claude 会围绕摄影主题创作视觉设计。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude first creates a design philosophy document (.md), then generates a visual poster (.png or .pdf) based on that philosophy. The output emphasizes handcrafted quality, minimal text, and focuses on graphics, shapes, and composition.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a poster, artwork, design, or other static visual piece.

say_en.text: Design a minimalist poster for me.
say_en.note: Claude will first write a design philosophy, then generate the poster.

say_en.text: Create a promotional image for my photography exhibition.
say_en.note: Claude will create a visual design around the photography theme.
